Visualize a Phylogenetic Tree with Optional Heatmap Annotation

tree_visualize.Rd

Visualize a Phylogenetic Tree with Optional Heatmap Annotation

Usage

tree_visualize(
  tree,
  hm_data = NULL,
  format.taxa = FALSE,
  parse = FALSE,
  nodelab_threshold = NULL,
  hm_layout = list(offset = 0.01, width = 0.1, label_margin = 0.02),
  hm_args = list(),
  base_args = list(tiplab_args = list(size = 3, align = TRUE), nodelab_args = list(size =
    3, nudge_x = 0.001, nudge_y = 0, hjust = 0), ggtree_args = list(size = 0.5), y.exp =
    c(0.01, 0.01)),
  palette = NULL,
  palette_mapping = NULL,
  contrast_factor = 0
)

Arguments

tree

A tidytree treedata object.

hm_data

Optional data.frame for heatmap annotation. If NULL, no heatmap is drawn.

format.taxa

Logical. Whether taxa names should be formatted for plotmath. Default is FALSE.

parse

Logical. Whether tip labels should be parsed as plotmath expressions. Default is FALSE.

nodelab_threshold

Numeric or NULL. Hide numeric node labels less than or equal to this value.

hm_layout

Named list of heatmap layout parameters (offset, width, label_margin).

hm_args

Named list of styling arguments passed to tree_annotate().

base_args

Named list of rendering arguments passed to .tree_visualize_base().

palette

Character vector or list of color vectors for heatmap annotations. Default is NULL.

palette_mapping

Named vector or list mapping annotation columns to palettes. Default is NULL.

contrast_factor

Numeric. Brightness adjustment factor passed to tree_annotate(). Default is 0.

Value

A ggtree plot object.

See also

Other tree: .tree_calc_offsets(), .tree_prep_labels(), .tree_visualize_base(), read_contree_mrbayes(), tree_annotate(), tree_relabel(), tree_reroot()
